_meta.status: Step 2 ratified (V3-V6, V15-V17); batch defaults rescaled for COMBAT.md squads
_meta.sources: DESIGN.md v0.4 §4 (calendar windows) · §10 (pools) · fighter.schema.json contract block + example (pricing calibration anchor)
provenance_notes: Everything here is (proposed) tuning data. The pricing model is calibrated so the schema's example fighter (Sczaa Vex: quality ~84 QP, prisoner, salary 400, auctioned ~2200) reproduces naturally.
quality_shift is the per-fighter talent offset added to every stat roll's mean; each pool samples it differently.
Prisoner contracts: freedom.divides_required is set PER CONTRACT (canon) — sampled from freedom_divides_weights at auction; divides_served starts at 0 for new lots.
Salary unit: credits per prep month (schema). death_benefit multiplies salary; Nattie pensions highest (canon, §9).
v0.2: batch_defaults 12 -> 8 to match the ratified squad size (COMBAT.md 2.1: 24-fighter drop force in three squads of eight). generateBatch(rng, {pool, count: 8}) now yields exactly one legal squad.
qp_weights re-tune from combat telemetry is [OPEN-C4], deferred to Step 3b/10 per COMBAT.md C11 — combat is designed clean and pricing follows it, not the reverse.
_meta.balance_note: All constants are batch-telemetry targets for Step 10; the roller exists so flavor can be judged before math is sacred.

stat_model.note: Per stat: round(normal(base_mean + quality_shift, base_sd)) + race lean, clamped; race stat_floor applied after.

potential_model.gap_by_age: Gap above current max stat shrinks with age: mean gap 5.0 at recruit_min, ~0.5 by prime end, floor 0.
potential_model.note: potential = clamp(maxCurrentStat + gap, maxCurrentStat, 20). HIDDEN — the roller's X-ray view shows truth; the broadcast view shows the scout estimate.

scout_model.note: Scout estimate = potential + normal(0, estimate_sd); shown as a ±1 star band (stars = round(est/star_divisor), 1–5).

nattie.label: Nattie Tryouts
nattie.death_benefit_note: Family pensions on your own ship — highest in the fleet (canon).
nattie.corp_note: Ship populations weight Nattie pools — races.json pool_weights × oa_profiles race_weights.
nattie.divide_bonus_note: Months of salary paid as a bonus for each Divide actually dropped into — the participation clause a merc's flat price conspicuously lacks. (proposed dial)

mercenary.label: Merc Market
mercenary.experience: veteran: divides ≈ 0.45 × years past prime start (cap 12); battles 2–5× divides; dividends 0–6
mercenary.seasons_note: RULED: a merc contract is ONE Divide. Extension is a fresh agreement at next year's market, by mutual consent — never a multi-year term. They are paid in full whether or not they drop; that is what the price buys.

prisoner.label: Kier Bastille Auction
prisoner.quality_note: High variance — the Bastille sells busts and diamonds in the same lot sheet.
prisoner.fame_note: Notoriety counts as fame. Fame measures how much attention is on a person, not whether the fleet is glad or sorry — see REPUTATION.md R11. A prisoner is not a category of heel.
prisoner.death_benefit_note: A Kier formality, not a pension.
prisoner.arrival_injury_note: Lots sell as-is: 15% arrive with a lingering minor injury (proposed).
prisoner.experience: checkered: some arrive green, some with prior Divides served under other banners
prisoner.negative_trait_note: Chance of one extra negative-tagged trait on top of the normal rolls: the Bastille does not sell finishing-school graduates. (proposed dial)

pricing.note: salary = round(salary_base × (QP/qp_norm)^qp_exponent × race salary_mult × pool salary_mult × prime_factor). Aim weighted highest — the sole attack aptitude.

trait_model.human_variety_note: races.json trait_variety_bonus adds +30% chance of one extra pool trait for humans.

special_lines.note: cradleborn_resentment rates live per-race in races.json; devotion in races.json etu.special; psionics in races.json gil.special.

trait_model.batch_repeat_note: Within one recruitment batch, each prior appearance of a trait multiplies its draw weight by this decay (shuffle-bag style anti-repetition). Deterministic; per-fighter distributions unchanged in isolation. (proposed)

callsigns.note: Broadcast nicknames are typically earned through fame events (schema); market veterans at fame ≥ 35 may arrive already carrying one.

batch_defaults.note: One squad per batch (COMBAT.md 2.1). A full drop force is three batches; a roster is 28-34.

origin_family_leans._note: Step d: where a hand learned its trades, in founding-scale points (x10 applied at birth). Keys are the pools above. Prisoners learned close and dirty; mercs carry long guns for pay; natties are ship-schooled, no lean.
